WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS rented_films
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rented_films) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT AVG(rc.rented_films) AS average_count,
       AVG(rc.rented_films - o.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rented_films > o.avg_count
